newsitem.title: USA: US West Coast refined prods prices slightly down.
newsitem.headline: US West Coast refined prods prices slightly down.

text.p: Wholesale prices for U.S. West Coast refined petroleum products were slightly weaker on Thursday amid a sharp fall on NYMEX futures, players said.
Activity was extremely thin, with many players on the sidelines due to the drop in NYMEX following Wednesday's sharp rise.
"The Merc is way down and we all backed away. It's really confusing," said a Los Angeles broker.
NYMEX rose on news Wednesday that OPEC will freeze production levels but then fell Thursday amid skepticism the oil group can rein in over-production.
Offers on Los Angeles CARB gasoline remained steady at 56.00 cents a gallon, traders said, with buyers at 55.00 cents.
Los Angeles CARB diesel, meanwhile, fell about 0.75 cent a gallon to 57/58 cents a gallon.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk 1212 859-1631 --
